title: Wesley
creator: CrossFit
description: On a 35-minute clock, run 800 m then as many rounds as possible of 8 box jumps, 6 strict pull-ups and a 21-yard walking lunge with a 45 lb plate overhead. Honours U.S. Air Force Tech. Sgt. Wesley Kubie of the Kansas Air National Guard, killed in a vehicle accident during training in 2021. Long AMRAP with strict pulling, so pace the pull-ups from round one.
